references.observations: Historical drawing opened: three granite arches and two piers; current granite parapets are appearance references, not engineering dimensions.

references.title: Baana below Fredrikinkatu, August2022
references.observations: Opened current available underpass view: continuous vertical masonry wingwalls, concrete deep fascia/inner bents, parallel underside girders, asphalt separated walking and cycle space with granite-sett strip. Source geometry supplies dimensions, not the photograph.

references.title: Hakaniemenranta current northern junction, August2026
references.observations: The upper bridge descends gently toward the ordinary zebra junction; no abrupt elevated endpoint cliff.

references.title: Canal banks south of Kanavakatu, September2016
references.observations: Older2016 photosphere, corroborated by current2024 northern bank view: sloped irregular pink/gray stone revetments, narrow steep waterline toes and flat paved tops. No pixel or metric height values are copied.

references.title: Hakaniemi western lower-walk waterside, September2025
references.observations: Opened September2025 view shows the current lower gray walk/red cycle strip and outer vertical pickets, with uninterrupted water immediately outside. No source gravel spur is visible in the central water-side witness area. Current pinned OSM coastline separately confirms water classification.

shoreClosureProtocol.water: Only current mapped water intersecting the changed bridge or source-removal footprint, minus original encoded water triangles, receives visual-only water faces at the original encoded global water level. Original water material and distant vertex colour are reused; no collision is added.

Only named source segments below the measured-5.3 cap are replaced; all other components, including80-segment nearshore gravel, and current high banks are protected. The separately enumerated original HCOL triangle2739 uses its exact footprint intersected with municipal gravel-road58744 and current OSM water, with measured maximum originalY-5.340782.
